The most recent Republican elected governor of New York was **George Pataki** in 1994.  
On the 1994 ballot, Pataki appeared under the following party lines (ballot‑line names):

| Ballot line | Party |
|-------------|-------|
| **Republican** | Republican Party (U.S.) |
| **Conservative** | Conservative Party of New York |

These two lines were the ones under which he was listed when he first won the governorship.
